summary:
Design & UI overhaul plan introducing:
1. Warm Cream & Pastel Blossom Palette (#FFF4DE, #FFDDDD, #FFCED8, #FFE8C4) with dual theme support (Soft Warm Cream light theme + Warm Velvet Espresso dark mode) and instant 1-tap toggle in HeaderBar.
2. Clean Information Architecture & Visual Hierarchy: Reorganized Today screen with Hero Greeting, quick action chips, categorized routine pills (Morning, Afternoon, Evening, Flexible), and collapsible widgets for 90-Day Sprint & Anti-Goals.
3. Supercharged AI Copilot with Tool Calling, Semantic Search, Behavioral Diagnostic Critique ('What am I doing wrong?'), What-To-Do-Next recommendations, and Android Text-to-Speech (TTS) voice playback.
